business_problem: Williams-Sonoma needed one platform that could personalize outreach across nine brands, handle very large send volumes reliably during peak seasons, and coordinate B2B selling and internal work without creating new silos.
solution_summary: Williams-Sonoma, Inc. built a multi-brand customer engagement stack on Salesforce so it can personalize outreach, support B2B selling, and automate internal work at retail scale. First- and third-party customer data flows into Data Cloud, where the company builds niche audiences such as college students or newlyweds from browsing history and transaction behavior. Marketing Cloud then triggers dynamic emails and SMS with tailored content across nine brands, while Salesforce Professional Services accelerated the joint Marketing Cloud and Data Cloud implementation to less than eight months instead of a typical 12-18-month program. Sales Cloud and Service Cloud support B2B ordering, negotiation, discounts, approvals, and post-sale service with order-management notifications pushed to reps in real time. Slack and dozens of integrations then connect teams internally so knowledge, workflows, and AI-driven automation can scale without heavy IT handoffs.
